resources.string: Screen capture copies only the visible pixels Android permits. Choose an app window in the Android prompt when available. On older devices, the whole display may be captured. Do not open password fields, disappearing content or screens you do not want saved. Captures are encrypted temporarily; return to Sakshi, unlock, review each frame, then choose a case to save. Screen lock, expiry or process death removes unreviewed drafts.

Capture visible text

Accessibility access can expose text from other apps. With your consent, Sakshi reads only visible text exposed by selected chat apps during a session of up to five minutes. Open ordinary conversations yourself; do not open View Once or disappearing-content screens during capture. No tapping, scrolling, replying or screenshots are automated. The vault locks when you leave Sakshi; temporary drafts stay in memory until review. Screen lock, revocation or process exit clears them. Recognisable restricted or sensitive screens stop capture, but detection is incomplete. Inaccessible content is never recovered. This cannot capture every message or authenticate the sender.
